package apigen

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/cloudcarver/anclax/pkg/logger"
	"github.com/gofiber/fiber/v3"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zapcore"
	"go.uber.org/zap/zaptest/observer"
)

type testValidator struct {
	t         *testing.T
	stage     string
	err       error
	writeBody bool
	calls     []string
}

func (v *testValidator) check(c fiber.Ctx, stage string) error {
	v.calls = append(v.calls, stage)
	if stage != v.stage {
		return nil
	}
	if v.writeBody {
		if err := c.JSON(map[string]string{"secret": "response-body-canary"}); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return v.err
}

func (v *testValidator) AuthFunc(c fiber.Ctx) error     { return v.check(c, "authentication") }
func (v *testValidator) PreValidate(c fiber.Ctx) error  { return v.check(c, "pre-validation") }
func (v *testValidator) PostValidate(c fiber.Ctx) error { return v.check(c, "post-validation") }
func (v *testValidator) OperationPermit(c fiber.Ctx, operationID string) error {
	if operationID != "ListWidgets" {
		v.t.Errorf("operation ID = %q", operationID)
	}
	return v.check(c, "authorization")
}

type testHandler struct{ called bool }

func (h *testHandler) ListWidgets(c fiber.Ctx) error {
	h.called = true
	return c.SendString("ok")
}

func TestSecurityResponsesAndLogs(t *testing.T) {
	stages := []string{"authentication", "pre-validation", "authorization", "post-validation"}
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		stage  string
		err    error
		status int
	}{
		{"authentication", errors.New("auth-error-canary: submitted-token-canary"), 401},
		{"pre-validation", errors.New("validation-error-canary"), 403},
		{"pre-validation", fmt.Errorf("private-cause-canary: %w", fiber.NewError(400, "fiber-error-canary")), 400},
		{"authorization", errors.New("permit-error-canary"), 403},
		{"authorization", fmt.Errorf("private-cause-canary: %w", fiber.NewError(429, "fiber-error-canary")), 429},
		{"post-validation", fmt.Errorf("private-cause-canary: %w", fiber.NewError(500, "fiber-error-canary")), 500},
	} {
		for _, writeBody := range []bool{false, true} {
			t.Run(fmt.Sprintf("%s/%d/body=%t", tc.stage, tc.status, writeBody), func(t *testing.T) {
				core, observed := observer.New(zapcore.WarnLevel)
				previousLog := xSecurityLog
				xSecurityLog = logger.NewLogAgentWithLogger("security", zap.New(core))
				t.Cleanup(func() { xSecurityLog = previousLog })

				app := fiber.New()
				validator := &testValidator{t: t, stage: tc.stage, err: tc.err, writeBody: writeBody}
				handler := &testHandler{}
				RegisterHandlers(app, NewXMiddleware(handler, validator))
				req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/widgets", nil)
				req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer submitted-token-canary")
				resp, err := app.Test(req)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				body, err := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
				if err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if err := resp.Body.Close(); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				if resp.StatusCode != tc.status || string(body) != http.StatusText(tc.status) {
					t.Fatalf("response = %d %q, want %d %q", resp.StatusCode, body, tc.status, http.StatusText(tc.status))
				}
				if got := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"); got != fiber.MIMETextPlainCharsetUTF8 {
					t.Errorf("content type = %q", got)
				}
				if handler.called {
					t.Error("protected handler was called after rejection")
				}
				for i, stage := range stages {
					if stage == tc.stage && !reflect.DeepEqual(validator.calls, stages[:i+1]) {
						t.Errorf("validation calls = %v, want %v", validator.calls, stages[:i+1])
					}
				}
				entries := observed.All()
				if len(entries) != 1 {
					t.Fatalf("security logs = %v", entries)
				}
				entry := entries[0]
				level := zapcore.WarnLevel
				if tc.status >= 500 {
					level = zapcore.ErrorLevel
				}
				if entry.Level != level || entry.ContextMap()["stage"] != tc.stage {
					t.Errorf("log = %v %v", entry.Level, entry.ContextMap())
				}
				if strings.Contains(entry.Message+fmt.Sprint(entry.ContextMap()), "canary") {
					t.Errorf("security log leaks a credential or private cause: %v", entry)
				}
			})
		}
	}
}
